senses.gloss: उद्- + अञ्जलि उद्- + अञ्जलि, adj. with uplifted hands, Daśak. in Chr. 180, 1.
उदक- + अन्त उदक- + अन्त, m. the bank of a river, Śāk. 54, 21.
उद्- + अम्भस् उद्- + अम्भस्, adj. abounding in water, Ragh. 4, 31.
उद्- + अर्चिस् उद्- + अर्चिस्, adj. radiant, Ragh. 7, 21.
उद्- + अश्रु उद्- + अश्रु, adj. shedding tears, Ragh. 12, 14.
उदय-आख्य उदय-आख्य, adj. called Udaya, Böhtl. Chr. 228, 166.
उद्- + आयुध उद्- + आयुध, adj. with raised weapons, Chr. 4, 17.

उद उद, a substitute for उदक in comp. words, e. g. उद-कुम्भ, m. A water-pot, Man. 2, 182.
 क्षार-, m. The salt ocean, Bhāg. P. 5, 1, 34.
 क्षीर-, m. The sea of milk, Rām. 4, 37, 28.
 गन्ध-, Fragrant water, Bhāg. P. 9, 11, 26.
 घृत-, m. The sea of clarified butter, Rām. 4, 40, 49.
 लोहित-, adj., f. दा, With blood-red water, Rām. 4, 44, 65.
 शान्ति-, n. Lustral water.

उदक उदक, i. e. उदन् + क, n.
 1. Water, Man. 2, 99.
 2. The ceremony of pouring water at obsequies, Man. 5, 88.
 3. Religious ablution, MBh. 1, 790.
 --Comp.
उदक्या उदक्या, i. e. उदक + य, f. A woman in her courses, Man. 4, 57.

उदग्र उद्-अग्र, adj., f. रा.
 1. Pointing upwards, lofty, Rām. 5, 54, 19; figuratively, Ragh. 2, 53.
 2. Uppermost, Vikr. d. 156.
 3. Excited, Rām. 6, 14, 15.

उदञ्च् उद्-अञ्च्, adj., f. उदीची.
 1. Upper, upwards.
 2. Northern, Megh. 58.
 उदक् (acc. sing. n.), adv. To the north, Man. 3, 217.
उदञ्चन उद्-अञ्च् + अन, m. A pail, Daśak. 152, 4.

उदधि उदधि, i. e. उद-धा (cf. निधि), m. The ocean, Daśak. in Chr. 188, 21.
 --Comp.

उदन् उदन्, i. e. उन्द् + अन्, n. Water, Chr. 291, 5 = Rigv. i. 85, 5.
 --Cf. ὕδωρ with ρ for न्; cf. also Lat. udor; Goth. vato, base vatan, represents the organic form of the vb. उन्द्, viz. वद्; O.H.G. wazar has र् instead of न्, like the Greek.
उदन्त उद्-अन्त, m. Tidings, Kathās. 10, 55.
उदन्वन्त् उदन् + वन्त्, m. The ocean, Ragh. 4, 32.

उदय उदय, i. e. उद्-इ + अ, m.
 1. Rising, Rām. 4, 34, 32 (of the ocean); Ragh. 12, 36 (of the moon); Man. 10, 33 (appearance of dawn); figuratively, Ragh. 9, 9; Rājat. 5, 311.
 2. The eastern mountain behind which the sun is supposed to rise, Rām. 4, 58, 5.
 3. Beginning, Bhāg. P. 1, 7, 12.
 4. Appearance, Śāk. d. 67.
 5. Prosperity, Rājat. 5, 336.
 6. Consequence, Man. 4, 70.
 7. Gain, Rām. 3, 2, 22; revenue, Man. 7, 55.
 8. A gate(?), Rām. 2, 48, 29.
 --Comp.

उदयन उदयन, i. e. उद्-इ + अन,
 I. n. Rising (of the sun), Chr. 287, 7 = Rigv. i. 48, 7; Rām. 4, 40, 43.
 II. m. A proper name, Kathās. 9, 599.
उदयवन्त् उदय + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Risen, Śiś. 9, 43.

उदर उदर, i. e. उद्-ऋ + अ, n.
 1. The belly.
 2. The interior part, Bhartṛ. 2, 26.
 --Comp.

उदार उदार, i. e. उद्-ऋ + अ, adj., f. रा and री,
 1. Distinguished, Nal. 1, 8.
 2. Excellent, Rām. 1, 35, 8.
 3. Great, MBh. 3, 13158.
 4. Gentle, Rām. 1, 33, 3.
 5. Munificent, Daśak. in Chr. 183, 4.
उदरंभरि उदरंभरि, i. e. उदर + म्-भृ + इ, adj. Voracious, Mālav. 14, 4.

उदरिन् उदरिन्, i. e. उदर + इन्, adj., f. इणी, Paunch-bellied, Kathās. 20, 109.
 --Comp.
उदक- + उदरिन् उदक- + उदरिन्, adj. hydropic.

उदर्क उदर्क, i. e. उद्-रिच्-अ (anomal.), m.
 1. Future time, Nal. 21, 26.
 2. Consequence, Rām. 6, 93, 14.
 --Comp.
उदात्त उदात्त, see दा with the prep. उद्-आ.
उदान उदान, i. e. उद्-अन् + अ, m. One of the five vital airs, that which has its place in the throat and passes upward and outward, Vedāntas. in Chr. 207, 11.
उद्दान उद्दान, i. e. उद्-दो + अन, n. Binding, MBh. 12, 4902.
उदारक उदार + क, adj. A poor munificent person, Daśak. in Chr. 186, 21; used as surname of one who has ruined himself by munificence, 187, 16.

उदारता उदार + ता, f. Generosity, Kathās. 21, 103.
 --Comp.
उदासीनता उद्-आसीन + ता (vb आस्), f. Indifference, carelessness, Pañc. 86, 12.

उदाहरण उदाहरण, i. e. उद्-आ-हृ + अन, n.
 1. Speaking, Kumāras. 6, 65.
 2. Declaration, Vikr. d. 32.
 3. An example.
उदक- + कार्य उदक- + कार्य, n. 1. ablution, MBh. 1, 791. 2. obsequies, Rām. 3, 72, 38.
उदकुम्भ उदकुम्भ, i. e. उदन्-, m. a water pot, Man. 2, 182.
उदक- + क्रिया उदक- + क्रिया, f. pouring water in honour of a deceased one, Man. 5, 69.
उदक- + क्रीडन उदक- + क्रीडन, n. playing in the water, MBh. 1, 4996.
उद्- + दण्ड उद्- + दण्ड, adj. with raised staff, Hit. ii. d. 28; stem, Ragh. 16, 46; arm, Prab. 81, 13.
उदक- + दान उदक- + दान, n. Pouring water in honour of a deceased one, Prab. 98, 3.
उदक- + दायिन् उदक- + दायिन्, m. a kinsman connected only by the oblations of water to the manes of common ancestors, Man. 5, 64.
उदार- + धी उदार- + धी, adj. high-minded, Chr. 44, 6. Cf. कु-, पर-द्रोह-कर्मन्-, adj. injuring another in deed or in thought, Man. 2, 161.
उद(न्)- + पात्र उद(न्)- + पात्र, n. a pot of water.
उदय- + प्रस्थ उदय- + प्रस्थ, the table-land on the top of the mountain, behind which the sun rises, Daśak. in Chr. 184, 4.
उदङ्मुख उदङ्मुख, i. e. उदञ्च्-, adj. facing the north, Man. 2, 52.
उदवास उदवास, i. e. उदन्-, m. abiding in water, MBh. 13, 354.
उदक- + विवध उदक- + विवध, and उद(न्)-वीवध-, m. a yoke for carrying water, Pāṇ. 6, 3, 60.
